verses.gurmukhi: ੫ : ਰਸਾਂ ਦੇ ਪੵਾਰੇ ਮਹਲ ਤੋਂ ਦੂਰ ਹਨ
verses.translit_en: 5 : rasaa(n) dhe payeaare mahal to(n) dhoor han

en.bdb: Pleasure seekers are away from His abode

verses.gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਲਖ ਰੂਪ ਸਰੂਪ ਅਨੂਪ ਸਿਧਾਵਹੀ।
verses.translit_en: lakh lakh roop saroop anoop sidhaavahee|

en.bdb: Millions of beauteous persons come to and go from this world
Millions of beauteous persons come to and go from this world and perform variegated activities.

verses.gurmukhi: ਰਾਗ ਨਾਦ ਵਿਸਮਾਦ ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਿ ਗਾਵਹੀ।
verses.translit_en: raag naadh visamaadh gun nidh gaavahee|

en.bdb: The rags (melodies) and nods (sounds) also being wonder-struck eulogise that ocean of attributes (the Lord).

verses.gurmukhi: ਰਸ ਕਸ ਲਖ ਸੁਆਦ ਚਖਿ ਚਖਾਵਹੀ।
verses.translit_en: ras kas lakh suaadh chakh chakhaavahee|

en.bdb: Millions taste and make others taste the edibles and inedibles.
Crores of people manage to make others enjoy the fragrance and varied smells.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੈਰ ਮਹਲਿ ਸੁਲਤਾਨ ਮਹਲ ਨ ਪਾਵਹੀ ॥੫॥
verses.translit_en: gair mahal sulataan mahal na paavahee ||5||

en.bdb: But those who consider the Lord of this (body) mansion as an alien, they all cannot attain His mansion.
